# Source and local adaptations

Source: [obra/superpowers, `skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md).
Pinned release: `v7.0.1`, commit `2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b`.
License: [MIT](LICENSE), preserved verbatim from that commit.
Source SHA-256: `61a7ef918652108c76a3fd01e02dd92d39996c6b46d4cb2819cbd03f6c45e46a`.

Echo rewrites the skill and adds explicit-only Codex metadata. Discovery,
material questions, alternatives and approval awareness remain; responsibilities
follow the existing spec/designer split. Automatic implementation planning,
subagents, browser setup, repository task documents, commits and mandatory
question/approval rounds are omitted. No upstream runtime or additional skills
are required. Owner approvals and Figma/tool access retain their existing rules.

For updates, review the pinned source changes and Echo boundaries, preserve the
license, update the pin/hash and validate the skill, links and role profiles.
